faqItems.question: What is Neuro Builds?
faqItems.answer: Neuro Builds is an AI-powered PC builder platform that helps you configure the perfect computer for your needs. Our intelligent system recommends components, checks compatibility, and connects you with a thriving community of PC enthusiasts.

faqItems.question: Is there a free version?
faqItems.answer: Yes! Our Starter plan is completely free and includes basic PC builder tools, limited component database, and community access. Upgrade to Pro or Enterprise for advanced features like AI recommendations and priority support.

faqItems.question: How does the AI recommendation work?
faqItems.answer: Simply answer a few questions about your budget, use case (gaming, streaming, editing), and preferences. Our AI analyzes millions of hardware combinations and recommends the best components for your specific needs.

faqItems.question: Can I buy components through Neuro Builds?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We have a secure peer-to-peer marketplace where you can buy, sell, and trade components with other users. You can also find direct purchase links to retailers for all recommended parts.

faqItems.question: Is compatibility checking really automatic?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. Our system automatically verifies that all components work together—checking power supply compatibility, motherboard socket types, RAM speed, GPU cooling, case dimensions, and more. We catch issues before they become problems.

faqItems.question: Do you offer customer support?
faqItems.answer: All plans include community support. Pro and Enterprise customers also get priority email support. We respond to questions within 24 hours and offer detailed guides, video tutorials, and live chat assistance.
